summary: Iteration 15: verified the four shipped items — (1) mechanical resolve (Fixed / Carry on) chat flow, (2) Member Since propagates to Member Card, (3) Member Card meta-label contrast bumped to rgba(255,255,255,0.75), (4) swipe-right on ride-detail returns to rides list. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass covering reporter self-resolve+404/400/403 permissions and admin-carry-on attributed to reporter. Frontend: end-to-end verified on mobile viewport 390x844 as El Prez (jb@glcc.club).

issues: The new '· swipe →' hint next to 'Back to Rides' is wrapped in 'hidden sm:inline', so on the mobile viewport (390px) it is display:none. The swipe gesture itself works, but the on-screen affordance the review request asked for is NOT visible to actual mobile users. Consider removing the 'hidden sm:inline' or replacing with 'sm:inline' visibility that still shows on mobile.

test_results.backend_resolve_reporter_fixed: PASS - resolved.resolved=true, resolution.status='fixed', by_name present; followup.text starts with '✅ Fixed'; followup.user_id === reporter; followup.system=false. GET /api/chat/messages includes muted original (resolved=true) + follow-up bubble.
test_results.backend_double_resolve_400: PASS - second resolve on same id returns 400 'Already resolved'.
test_results.backend_non_reporter_non_admin_403: PASS - sam trying to resolve mika's mechanical returns 403.
test_results.backend_admin_carry_on_attrib_to_reporte: PASS - admin (jb) resolving sam's mechanical produces follow-up starting with '🚴 Carry on', followup.user_id === sam's id, resolution.by_name === admin name.
test_results.frontend_mechanical_fixed_e2e: PASS - jb sends mechanical (no location), mechanical-clear-<id> row shows both mechanical-fixed-<id> and mechanical-carry-<id> buttons; tapping Fixed removes clear row, applies muted styling (text-neutral-500) with strikethrough on body, shows 'Mechanical · Resolved' eyebrow and 'Fixed · by Jason Bryant' resolution line; '✅ Fixed — on my way.' follow-up bubble appears in chat.
test_results.frontend_member_since_propagation: PASS - Set member_since to 2019-01-15 in ProfileModal, saved, reopened profile -> VIEW MEMBER CARD -> data-testid='member-card-since' reads 'Jan 2019'.
test_results.frontend_member_card_contrast_self: PASS - all five meta labels (Member No., Role, Since, Chapter, Coffee) computed color rgba(255,255,255,0.75).
test_results.frontend_member_card_contrast_other: PASS - same verified for a non-self rider (Graeme Bean).
test_results.frontend_swipe_right_ride_detail: PASS - CDP touch swipe from x=+50 to x=+280 across ride-detail closes it and restores rides-list. Swipe hint span exists in DOM but hidden at 390px (see design_issues).

action_items: Optional: remove 'hidden sm:inline' from the '· swipe →' hint in RidesTab.jsx (line 164) so the affordance is visible on mobile viewports; otherwise the on-screen hint promised in the review request is invisible to mobile users.
critical_code_review_comments: resolve_mechanical (server.py:2094-2151) correctly enforces reporter-or-admin, blocks double resolve, broadcasts chat.updated + chat.message, and attributes follow-up to the original reporter while retaining admin identity in resolution.by_name. Solid design.
ChatTab.jsx canClear guard `m.user_id === user.id || user.is_admin` matches backend permission model — no client-side leakage of the buttons to unauthorized viewers.
MemberCard.jsx joinedSource uses `rider.member_since || rider.created_at` which is correct fallback; MemberCard testid `member-card-since` reflects the new value.
RidesTab.jsx swipe uses threshold dx>65 AND |dx| > 1.6*|dy| — sane, avoids conflict with vertical scroll. But the visible hint is hidden on the exact viewport the app targets (mobile).
